title: Zigbee Mesh Link-Quality Weak Spots
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue events (`hue:event`), thermostats (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT bridged to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device
| stats avg(linkquality) as avg_lqi, min(linkquality) as min_lqi by friendly_name
| where avg_lqi<40
| sort avg_lqi
description: Finds smart-home devices with a weak wireless link so you can add a repeater or move a router device before they start dropping off the mesh.
value: Weak mesh links cause the maddening intermittent failures that are impossible to reproduce; surfacing them turns guesswork into a fix.
implementation: Bridge Zigbee link-quality reports; schedule daily and review the weakest devices to plan repeater placement.
visualization: Table of devices by average link quality.
grandmaExplanation: It finds the smart-home gadgets with a poor wireless signal, so you can fix them before they act up.
